name: Harry Leshner
office: Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District, Member of the Board of Education

items.text: Harry Leshner is a technology partnerships executive and an education nonprofit board member.

sentences.text: Harry Leshner is a technology partnerships executive and an education nonprofit board member.

items.text: He supports expanding affordable after-care and a technology policy that limits screen time and restricts classroom AI. He supports the 2025 agreements to split the district into separate Santa Monica and Malibu districts, and says he would focus on maintaining program quality and financial health during the transition.
